cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8.3)
project(libcmt)
include(ExternalProject)

## Find catkin macros and libraries
## if COMPONENTS list like find_package(catkin REQUIRED COMPONENTS xyz)
## is used, also find other catkin packages
# execute_process(COMMAND
#   git config --global http.sslVerify false)
## System dependencies are found with CMake's conventions
# find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS system)
# the archive of github.com/delmottea/libCMT at the commit, kept in jsk-ros-pkg/archives, as the archive
# generated by GitHub at each request sometimes fails
set(LIBCMT_URL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsk-ros-pkg/archives/master/libCMT-e4d7ea42edafe13b1070ef4d595b2d6062d79d1a.zip)
# ExternalProject tries the URLs in turn (CMake 3.7 and later): the same URL again, and the archive of
# GitHub, for a transient error of the network (e.g. of the CI)
if(NOT CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.7)
  set(LIBCMT_URL ${LIBCMT_URL} ${LIBCMT_URL} https://github.com/delmottea/libCMT/archive/e4d7ea42edafe13b1070ef4d595b2d6062d79d1a.zip)
endif()
# with JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR (e.g. a cache of the CI), the file is downloaded there, and is not
# downloaded again while its hash matches
if(NOT "$ENV{JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
  set(LIBCMT_DOWNLOAD_DIR DOWNLOAD_DIR $ENV{JSK_3RDPARTY_DOWNLOAD_DIR})
endif()
ExternalProject_Add(
  libcmt
  URL ${LIBCMT_URL}
  ${LIBCMT_DOWNLOAD_DIR}
  URL_HASH MD5=9113175f01cb9c62e60ba46415c657cb
  PATCH_COMMAND cat ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/fix_opencv3.patch ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/fix_cmakelists.patch | patch -p1
  CMAKE_ARGS -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}
  INSTALL_COMMAND echo "install"
  )

install(CODE "execute_process(COMMAND make install WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libcmt-prefix/src/libcmt-build)")
